Twenty-two people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

VILLANUEVA, MARCOS

VILLANUEVA, MARCOS was arrested on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 12:15 a.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the record.

GARCIA, BRANDON LEE was arrested on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 1:56 a.m. on an alleged charge of interference with an emergency request for assistance, a Class A misdemeanor, and assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000 on one charge and had not been set on the other. The arresting agency was not listed in the record.
